name: Vegetable Moilee
steps: Cut vegetables to similar bite-sized pieces. Heat coconut oil in a deep pan and cook sliced onion 5 minutes until soft and translucent, not browned.
Add ginger, slit green chili and curry leaves; stir for 1 minute. Add potato, carrot and beans with turmeric, salt and 250 ml water.
Cover and simmer 7 minutes, then add cauliflower and cook 5 more minutes until all vegetables are just tender. Keep the broth pale and gently flavored.
Pour in coconut milk and black pepper. Warm gently for 4–5 minutes without a hard boil so the milk stays smooth and vegetables keep their shape.
Turn off heat, stir in lemon juice and taste salt. Serve the fragrant coconut stew with appam or steamed rice.
tips: Moilee is a delicate pale coconut-milk stew; do not darken it with roasted red masala.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
